hooks.command: [ -f .build/ci/bootstrap-repo.sh ] || git -C .build symbolic-ref -q HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 || git submodule update --init --recursive -q 2>/dev/null; [ -f .build/ci/bootstrap-repo.sh ] && bash .build/ci/bootstrap-repo.sh || true
echo '✅ embacle workspace ready - git hooks configured'
bash -c 'command -v gh &>/dev/null && gh auth status &>/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "CI_MONITORING=gh" || echo "CI_MONITORING=fallback"'
